ligger.noot: Loads, cross-section and checks are in the calculation sheet; positions are measured from the left end.
ligger.aanzicht: Elevation with characteristic loads and bending moment diagram (G + Q, all loads)
ligger.beweeglijk: mechanism: too few supports or one hinge too many
ligger.klik: Click a blue dimension or a load to edit it — the change flows straight back into the calculation sheet.
ligger.inBlad: Combinations, envelope and checks are in the calculation sheet.

tweepaalspoer.staafwerk: Orange: checked truss. Dimensions in mm.
tweepaalspoer.noot: The other input and the checks are in the calculation sheet. Without confirmation of the transverse stability the sheet gives no overall result.
tweepaalspoer.klik: Click a blue dimension to change it — it flows straight back into the calculation sheet.
tweepaalspoer.modelBeperkt: The model shows {{getoond}} of the {{totaal}} bars: more cannot usefully be drawn.

model.alleenAanzet: Only the starter is drawn; the length is outside this sheet.

vormenLang.i: I or H section with root radii: from the list or with your own dimensions
vormenLang.t: T with the flange on top, without radii
vormenLang.u: U with the web on the left and parallel flanges, without radii

doorsnede.noot: Mechanics, not a code check. Torsion and local effects are not included. The working is in the calculation sheet.
doorsnede.klik: Change a field or click a blue dimension: the field and the diagrams follow at once.

tekening.ongeldig: These dimensions do not make a section: see the message in the calculation sheet.
tekening.afspraak1: y to the right, z downwards, origin at the centroid. Red is tension (+), blue is compression (−).
tekening.afspraak2: M_y: tension at +z. M_z: tension at +y. V_y and V_z in the direction of +y and +z.

overstek.label: With a cantilever at one end

balklaag.oudBlad: This sheet was made with an older version; insert the joist floor again to get the supporting beam and custom size options.
balklaag.belasteBreedteUitleg: For joists continuous over two equal spans 1,25 × L; for separate joists on either side, the sum of the half spans.
balklaag.opleglengteSteunUitleg: Bearing length at the intermediate support; for joists on a supporting beam, the width of that beam. Counts in the bearing stress check (§6.1.5).

tbalk.label: T-beam: joist with the floor panel as effective flange (EN 1995-1-1 §9.1.2)

tbalk.nogTeControleren: To be checked: the T-beam check has not yet been verified against reference sheets.
tbalk.verlijmd: The panel is assumed glued to the joists over the full length. A nailed or screwed panel falls under annex B (γ-method), not under this sheet.
tbalk.fabrikantMultiplex: Plywood: enter the manufacturer's values, in the direction of the joists (EN 636, EN 12369-2).
tbalk.fabrikantSpaanplaat: Particleboard or fibreboard: enter the manufacturer's values, in the direction of the joists, and k_mod and k_def from tables 3.1 and 3.2 for the type.
tbalk.onvolledig: Panel data incomplete or out of range (OSB/3: 6 < t ≤ 25 mm, service class 1 or 2): the T-beam is not verified.
tbalk.nvt: The T-beam applies to a joist in a floor; for a supporting beam or trimmer the sheet calculates the rectangular joist.

ontwerp.uitleg: picks the first section in the list that passes
ontwerp.geen: No section in the list passes. Reduce the c/c spacing or the span, choose a higher strength class, or enter a custom size.
ontwerp.al: {{profiel}} already passes — there is no lighter section in this list.
ontwerp.gekozen: {{profiel}} selected: the first section that passes.

binnen.label: 1 — heated interior
binnen.uitleg: Service class 1 — moisture content corresponding to 20 °C and a relative humidity that exceeds 65 % for only a few weeks per year. Average moisture content at most 12 %. Typical: heated, enclosed interiors.

overdekt.label: 2 — covered, unheated
overdekt.uitleg: Service class 2 — 20 °C and a relative humidity that exceeds 85 % for only a few weeks per year. Average moisture content at most 20 %. Typical: covered but open or unheated — carport, ventilated crawl space, unheated attic.

buiten.label: 3 — exterior / damp
buiten.uitleg: Service class 3 — conditions leading to a higher moisture content than service class 2. Typical: unprotected exterior or permanently damp spaces. Gives the lowest k_mod and the highest creep factor.

balklaag.gedragenUitleg: Self-weight of the joists resting on this beam, per m² of floor; the sheet adds it to G_k. For example 71×221 at 600 c/c in C24: about 0,11 kN/m².
balklaag.drieDAfdrukkenUitleg: A small image at the end of the sheet. Off by default, to keep the printout short.
balklaag.onderslagTrilling: A supporting beam has no vibration check; that belongs to the joist floor it carries.
balklaag.schemaKop: Static system — characteristic loads per joist
balklaag.omhullendNoot: Safe envelope: maxima of permanent and point load added,
balklaag.klik: Click a blue dimension to change it.

wissel.lengteSparingUitleg: Along the joists. 0: the opening runs up to the support and there is one trimmer. Otherwise there is a second trimmer on the other side, with its own tail.
wissel.overspanningUitleg: Centre to centre of the supports. Empty: that of the joist floor (clear span plus bearing length).

afdruk.nietDoorgerekend: This sheet could not be calculated:
afdruk.rekenwijzeNorm: the code followed at the marked points
afdruk.rekenwijzeReferentie: the reference calculation followed at the marked points
afdruk.nietGetoetstEen: {{n}} of the {{totaal}} parts is not verified; see the sheet concerned.
afdruk.nietGetoetstMeer: {{n}} of the {{totaal}} parts are not verified; see the sheets concerned.
afdruk.nietGoedEen: {{n}} of the {{totaal}} parts is not OK; see the sheet concerned.
afdruk.nietGoedMeer: {{n}} of the {{totaal}} parts are not OK; see the sheet concerned.
afdruk.ucNoot: UC is the governing unity check of the sheet; — means the sheet has no final check.

varianten.uitleg: {{naam}} with other input; input not listed is the same as in the sheet above.

twRcBeam.noot: Loads, materials and checks are in the sheet; the view does not calculate.
twRcBeam.klik: Click a blue dimension to edit it; the value is written back to the sheet.

twRetainingWall.noot: The sheet has no groundwater input, so no water line is drawn; the dashed line is the Rankine wedge (45° + φ/2).
twRetainingWall.doorsnede: Section: stem, toe, heel and active wedge
twRetainingWall.klik: Click a blue dimension to edit it; the value is written back to the sheet.

twDetentionBasin.noot: Below the orifice invert is dead storage; the dashed line is the emergency spillway level (design level + overflow depth).
twDetentionBasin.doorsnede: Section: floor, slopes, design level, orifice and spillway
twDetentionBasin.klik: Click a blue dimension to edit it; the value is written back to the sheet.

twWindLoad.titel: Parametric view — wind pressure (site wind speed)
twWindLoad.noot: Recommended values come from ABRI open data ({{aantal}} districts, year 114) and are for reference only; confirm they match V10(C) of code clause 2.4.
twWindLoad.klik: Pick a district and press Apply; V10 is written back to the sheet.

twSeismicLoad.titel: Parametric view — seismic load (site zone & near-fault parameters)
twSeismicLoad.noot: Based on Taiwan Seismic Code (seis113) Tables 2-1, 2-3-1, 2-3-2, 2-4(a)/(b) and 2-6(b) ({{aantal}} general-zone districts). Taipei Basin microzones are excluded.
twSeismicLoad.klik: Pick a district, site class and fault distance, then press Apply; S_DS and S_D1 are written back to the sheet.
